This page indexes the real examples already present in the repository. It does
not imply that every upstream survey cutout can be redistributed or reproduced
without its original data access and calibration context.

## Sagui-10 {#sagui-10-main-example}

```{r sagui10, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Sagui-10 photometric SED segmentation. Colours are categorical region labels."}
path <- system.file("help", "figures", "sagui10_n20.png", package = "sagui")
knitr::include_graphics(path)
```

The site-ready image is `images/examples/sagui10_n20.png`. The regional SED fit
shown below is retained as a verified repository asset; consult the provenance
table before treating it as reproducible from public inputs alone.

```{r sagui10-sed, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Regional SED fit retained with the Sagui-10 example."}
path <- system.file(
  "help",
  "figures",
  "sagui10_sedfit_region_1.png",
  package = "sagui"
)
knitr::include_graphics(path)
```

## Faint bridge {#sagui-11-faint-bridge}

```{r bridge, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Sagui-11 low-surface-brightness composite and copula-pretransformed segmentation."}
base <- system.file("help", "figures", package = "sagui")
knitr::include_graphics(c(file.path(base, "sagui11_lsb_composite.png"), file.path(base, "sagui11_lsb_copula.png")))
```

The copula transform is an analysis choice, not a neutral display transform.
Compare it with an untransformed run before interpreting the bridge.

## Target S/N {#target-sn-selection}

```{r target-snr, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Sagui-10 candidate selected under a minimum regional S/N threshold of 10."}
path <- system.file(
  "help",
  "figures",
  "sagui10_target_snr_10.png",
  package = "sagui"
)
knitr::include_graphics(path)
```

The producer is `scripts/make_sagui10_target_snr_panel.R`; machine-readable
candidate and selection tables live under
`images/examples/target_snr/sagui10/`. The threshold must be read together with
the variance model and candidate grid.

## Bagpipes hand-off

```{r bagpipes, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Bagpipes model photometry for Sagui-8 region 8, generated from a Sagui regional SED."}
path <- system.file(
  "help",
  "figures",
  "sagui8_region8_bagpipes_sedfit.png",
  package = "sagui"
)
knitr::include_graphics(path)
```

The producer is `scripts/make_sagui8_bagpipes_sedfit_example.py`; its generated
model photometry is in `outputs/website_sedfit/`. Bagpipes remains an optional
downstream interface rather than part of Sagui's segmentation algorithm.
